biotools.summary: scQTLtools is an R/Bioconductor package designed for comprehensive single-cell expression quantitative trait locus (eQTL) analysis, from preprocessing to visualization. It supports various input formats and statistical models for dissecting genotype-expression relationships in heterogeneous cellular populations.
